This is Sigrún, in Grindavik. At three in the morning, she was packing for a flight.
Then the ground opened outside town. The airport departure board started cancelling flights.
Sigrún joined the road out. A sign assured drivers the queue was moving smoothly.
At the shelter, the power went out. The glowing exit sign became the room's main attraction.
By evening, every flight was grounded. The board still asked everyone to keep checking.
Day two: help from Norway. Officials posed beside the supplies before unloading them.
Day three: the power came back. Her flight did not.
